text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After hanging out with Tazuna-san and the others.
We decided to wrap up the day at an izakaya.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I know a great seafood spot~!
This way♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, how exciting... Oh?
Those people over there are—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I knew it♪
Tsurugi-san and Sonon Elfie-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Athlete UmaTuber Sonon Elfie.
And entertainment producer Suzuka Tsurugi!

text_block_list.name: Tsurugi Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Tazuna-san and Hello-san!
Trainer <username>-san as well,
thank you for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Tsurugi Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, are you all heading out
for a meal together?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, we were just talking about
going to an izakaya with great seafood♪

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Great seafood... huh?
Could it be the place just down this way?
That's where we were heading, too!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! In that case,
won't you join us?♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: —'Closed today due to birth of grandchild'...!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry...!
Who would've thought such happy news would coincide with today.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Nah, can't be helped!
We'll just save this place for next time—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, Suzuka-san?
What are you looking up?

text_block_list.name: Tsurugi Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Looking for another place.
Can't quite decide, though...

text_block_list.name: Tsurugi Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Somewhere we can stay long and unwind without reserve...
After all, this group gathering together
is pretty rare, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I know exactly what you mean!
Since we're all here, I want to chat about so many things...!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Work stuff, plus other things, just nibbling on good food
and chatting lazily away...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurugi Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Right? So—

text_block_list.name: Tsurugi Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we rent a space that allows outside food,
bring whatever we like...
and have drinks there?

text_block_list.name: Tsurugi Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe, exactly.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san...!
Brilliant idea! Sounds like tons of fun!

text_block_list.name: Tsurugi Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Leave sashimi and local sake to me. As for the rest,
bring whatever you fancy!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
My goodness...!
Let's definitely do that♪

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the intrusion~!
I bought egg tarts, pies, and anmitsu
from shop I'm obsessed with lately~!
choice_data_list: Going all-in on desserts, I see!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Gyoza here♪
And... caught delicious smell on the way here,
so picked up some yakitori too.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
It's collab item, but check out
'Protein Carrot Cake' supervised by me!
Please dig in!

text_block_list.name: Tsurugi Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, wonderful project.
...And from me, as promised,
sashimi and local sake.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san! Mind if I stand behind counter
and act as master of the house?
Always wanted to try that!

text_block_list.name: Tsurugi Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... guess I'll leave it to you.
Master, recommended drink, please.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Across pushed-together tables.
Brought-in dishes lack any uniformity,
some still sitting right in shopping bags.
choice_data_list: Has charming homemade feel to it...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Totally get that... Feels just like
throwing secret snack party
in classroom after school.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Hafwo-san!
Egg farts so deficious!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ah, glad to hear!
Ehehe, then I'll help myself
to Elfie-san's cake too♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, this local sake!
Truly living up to Tsurugi-san's recommendation♪

text_block_list.name: Tsurugi Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Glad it suits your taste.
Try seared cutlassfish too,
with splash of lemon juice.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh my! How refined and tasteful...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Was disappointing when izakaya was closed
at first... but turned out wonderfully
in the end, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Tsurugi Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, indeed.
Nights that don't go to plan make things interesting... or rather—

text_block_list.name: Tsurugi Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Nights where you make them interesting.
Those certainly exist.
choice_data_list: Staying flexible lets you enjoy everything.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Beyond what was initially imagined—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fun and newfound fulfillment
lie waiting.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Or maybe,
I've had bit too much to drink. Fufu♪

text_block_list.name: Tsurugi Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Hearing it said so earnestly
makes me feel bit embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Nevertheless, yes... it's profound.

text_block_list.name: Tsurugi Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Not you too, Tazuna-san...

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
That's so trueee~!
Suzuka-san really is super deep~~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurugi Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, Elfie too...!
Drank too much, confiscated!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Coughing clears throat, followed by soft giggles.
One-night-only izakaya
was just getting started...
